audit_name: Phase 8.2D Recognition Utility and Safety Audit

positive_calibration_label_Y_1.definition: Specimen is an in-catalog monument AND Top-1 retrieved candidate matches ground-truth monument key (pred_key == gt_key).
positive_calibration_label_Y_1.semantic_meaning: Correct Top-1 Retrieval by visual embedding encoder (not a verification decision).

negative_calibration_label_Y_0.definition: Specimen is a non-monument distractor, an out-of-catalog unknown heritage monument, OR an in-catalog monument whose Top-1 prediction was incorrect.
negative_calibration_label_Y_0.semantic_meaning: Incorrect retrieval outcome or out-of-distribution distractor.
negative_calibration_label_Y_0.condition: category in ['unknown_heritage', 'non_monument'] or (category == 'catalog' and recognized_label != ground_truth_label)

out_of_catalog_heritage_handling.definition: Ground truth label is 'unknown_heritage'. Assigned Y=0 for in-catalog calibration.

non_monument_handling.definition: Ground truth label is 'non_monument'. Assigned Y=0 for in-catalog calibration.

decision_system_vs_retrieval_distinction.crucial_audit_rule: Y in calibration models represents RETRIEVAL correctness P(Y=1 | s). The Decision System arbitrates 5 discrete operational states (VERIFIED_MATCH, UNCERTAIN_MATCH, etc.). A query with Y=1 can receive UNCERTAIN_MATCH if margin < 0.08 or GPS is missing. Therefore, retrieval accuracy and decision verification recall must be reported separately.

false_rejection_rate_FRR.interpretation: 100.0% of in-catalog queries were rejected from automatic verified status due to margin/GPS thresholds.

verification_precision.note: 0.0 (Undefined mathematically because zero verified decisions were issued; denominator is 0)

verification_recall.interpretation: 0.0% automatic verification recall on Split C.

descriptive_pooled_cross_split_bounds.warning: Descriptive only. Split B and Split C originate from distinct collection runs and cannot be formally pooled as i.i.d.
